moments.title: Black Friday & Cyber Monday Deals
moments.blurb: Black Friday is today, November 27th, with Cyber Monday following on November 30th, marking the peak of the UK's biggest shopping weekend.

angles.name: Shopping Frenzy
angles.copy: It's officially Black Friday! Whether you're hunting for tech, fashion, or early Christmas gifts, the deals are dropping fast. What's on your wishlist this year?

angles.name: Cyber Weekend Starts
angles.copy: Black Friday isn't just today, it's kicking off a whole weekend of sales leading into Cyber Monday. Grab those bargains, but shop smart!

angles.name: Best UK Deals
angles.copy: From Amazon to John Lewis, the UK's biggest retailers are going all out for Black Friday. Share your best finds with us!

moments.title: Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' UK No.1
moments.blurb: Welsh artist Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' holds the UK Official Singles Chart Number 1 for a sixth consecutive week, making it the longest-reigning chart-topper by a Welsh artist in 56 years.

source.l: Official Charts Company / Hits Daily Double

angles.name: Welsh No.1 Reign
angles.copy: Huge congrats to Welsh star Jamie Miller! 'Babydoll' is Number 1 for a sixth week, matching a 56-year record for a Welsh artist. Incredible!

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still can't get enough of 'Babydoll'? Jamie Miller is dominating the UK Singles Chart. Is this your favourite track right now?

angles.name: Welsh Pride
angles.copy: Jamie Miller flying the flag for Wales at the top of the charts! What a moment for Welsh music. Tune in for 'Babydoll'!

moments.title: Take That Score 10th UK No.1 Album
moments.blurb: Take That's new album 'Dreamers' has debuted at Number 1 on the UK Official Albums Chart, marking their 10th chart-topping album and the biggest opening week for a group in 2026.

angles.name: Take That's 10th No.1
angles.copy: They've done it again! Take That's 'Dreamers' is the UK's Number 1 album, their tenth chart-topper! What's your favourite track from the new record?

angles.name: New Album Out Now
angles.copy: If you haven't heard it yet, Take That's new album 'Dreamers' is flying high at Number 1. Get ready for some classic pop anthems!

angles.name: Pop Royalty
angles.copy: Only The Beatles and The Rolling Stones have more UK No.1 albums than Take That. Pop royalty indeed! Celebrating their latest success.

moments.title: Christmas Classics Return to UK Top 10
moments.blurb: Festive favourites 'Last Christmas' by Wham! and 'All I Want For Christmas Is You' by Mariah Carey have re-entered the UK Official Singles Chart Top 10 as the race for Christmas Number 1 begins.

angles.name: Christmas Chart Invasion
angles.copy: It's happening! Wham! and Mariah Carey are back in the Top 10. The festive takeover of the charts has officially begun! Which Christmas classic is your favourite?

angles.name: Mariah vs Wham!
angles.copy: The annual battle for Christmas chart domination is underway! Mariah Carey and Wham! are already in the Top 10. Who will win this year?

angles.name: Festive Feel-Good
angles.copy: Nothing gets you in the mood like those classic Christmas tunes. Elton John, Brenda Lee, Kelly Clarkson also climbing the charts! Get ready to sing along.

moments.title: UK Snooker Championship Underway
moments.blurb: The 2026 UK Snooker Championship officially began today, November 27th, at the York Barbican and runs until December 6th.

angles.name: Snooker Kicks Off
angles.copy: Break off! The UK Snooker Championship is live from York. Who are you backing to lift the trophy this year?

angles.name: Green Baize Action
angles.copy: Ten days of top-class snooker begin today in York. Don't miss a moment of the UK Championship action!

angles.name: York Hosts Champs
angles.copy: The eyes of the snooker world are on York as the UK Championship gets underway. Any local talent to watch out for?

angles.name: Rugby Finals Weekend

angles.name: All I Want For Christmas

angles.name: London Gets Festive

moments.title: Happy Birthday Charlie Burchill (Simple Minds)

angles.name: Simple Minds Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating 67 years of Charlie Burchill! The iconic Simple Minds guitarist is still bringing the magic. What's your favourite Simple Minds track?

angles.name: Don't You Forget About Him
angles.copy: Happy 67th to Simple Minds' Charlie Burchill! From 'Don't You (Forget About Me)' to 'Alive and Kicking,' his guitar work is legendary.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Myles Kennedy
moments.blurb: Myles Kennedy, the acclaimed frontman of Alter Bridge and vocalist for Slash's solo band, turns 57 today, November 27th.

angles.name: Rock Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 57th Birthday to the incredible Myles Kennedy! From Alter Bridge to Slash, his voice is unmistakable. What's your top Myles Kennedy song?

angles.name: Voice of a Generation
angles.copy: A huge voice in rock turns 57 today! Wishing Myles Kennedy a fantastic birthday. Keep those anthems coming!

angles.name: Iconic Pop Birthday
angles.copy: From 'Baby One More Time' to 'Toxic', Britney Spears has given us so many hits. Wishing her a fabulous 45th on December 2nd!

angles.name: Metal God's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 78th Birthday to the one and only Ozzy Osbourne this Thursday! A true icon of rock and roll.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Jay-Z

angles.copy: From Brooklyn to global mogul, Jay-Z has shaped music and culture. Happy 57th birthday to him on Friday!

moments.title: GTA VI Soundtrack Boosts UK Chart
moments.blurb: The recent release of Grand Theft Auto VI is significantly impacting the UK Singles Chart, with soundtrack cuts like Justice, Tame Impala & SZA's 'Flower In A Hurricane' at #3 and Carly Rae Jepsen's 'Run Away With Me' re-entering the Top 40.

source.l: Official Charts Company / Hits Daily Double

angles.name: Gaming to Charts
angles.copy: GTA VI isn't just a game, it's a chart-mover! Tracks from the soundtrack are storming the UK Top 40, including Justice and Carly Rae Jepsen. What's your favourite GTA track?

angles.name: Soundtrack Success
angles.copy: The power of Grand Theft Auto! Its soundtrack is making huge waves in the UK charts. Proof that a great game needs great music!

angles.name: Carly Rae Jepsen Revival
angles.copy: 'Run Away With Me' in the Top 40 thanks to GTA VI? We love to see it! Which other classics deserve a chart comeback?
